description: Tier 1 functional WAAPI tests for the Immerse Audio Renderer. Each assertion is preceded by a setup that forces the opposite value so the assertion is a real transition (Wwise does not push when setProperty is called with the current value). Currently asserted: EnableImmerse (bool master switch) and ConvolutionType values 0 (stereo) and 1 (personalized). ConvolutionType=2 (universal) and HeadphoneEq are skipped pending dev-team clarification on their preconditions -- both return HTTP 500 from WAAPI in the current configuration. UserID change tests are intentionally absent pending manual verification that user-switching mid-remote-connect is safe.

scenarios.name: EHM: assert ON  (off -> on, for downstream scenarios)
ConvolutionType: setup -> 0 stereo (force transition for next assert)
ConvolutionType: 2 universal (SKIPPED - returns HTTP 500, dev-team check)
scenarios.comment: WAAPI returns 500 for value=2 regardless of preceding state. Likely a license/feature gate or precondition (e.g. non-personalized user account). Confirm with dev team whether universal mode is settable via setProperty in this build, or whether it requires a different API.

scenarios.name: HeadphoneEq: any value (SKIPPED - all return HTTP 500, dev-team check)
scenarios.comment: Every HeadphoneEq setProperty call returns 500, including with EnableImmerse=true and ConvolutionType=1 (personalized) already set as preconditions. May require: (a) HPEQ profile data already downloaded for the user, (b) ConvolutionType to be in a steady state for some time, (c) a different WAAPI verb. Confirm with dev team.
